output.content: The audit findings are unacceptable. I need the API gateway to reach a fully governed state immediately. We must implement automated authentication controls and continuous compliance checks to satisfy external regulators. A manual process is too risky for our current security posture. I want every endpoint protected by strict identity verification. The more automated and governed the system becomes, the better our standing with auditors. I am pushing for the highest level of control possible to ensure we meet all privacy and security standards without exception.
